manifest.dataPolicy: Embedded synthetic Test Solution fixtures; not copied from AI artifacts.

testDataLimitations: Section 5 fixtures are classifier-oracle harness payloads with Segment 100 presence; they are not converter-ready ATL105 messages.
Receipt fixtures test expected label mappings only; they do not claim to execute receipt formatting or prove which input card codes select each receipt ID.

blockedRequirements.reason: No source-backed Section 5 leaf to Prompt Code/card code/companion/lifecycle/response mapping. No TS, TC, or TD is generated.
Receipt output shape and application of the generic Debit, EBT, and STAR Signature Debit IDs need Test Team confirmation. The mapping harnesses do not claim to render receipts.
